component.name: TabTube
component.summary: A private YouTube client with tabs

description.p: TabTube is a private YouTube client with browser-style tabs. It is an unofficial fork of FreeTube (and is not affiliated with the FreeTube project).

ul.li: Open videos and channels in independent tabs
Middle-click or Ctrl/Cmd-click opens a new background tab — your current video keeps playing
Background tabs don't autoplay; a tab plays only when you switch to it
All of FreeTube's privacy features, player, subscriptions and playlists

description.p: Initial TabTube release: browser-style tabs on top of FreeTube.
